overall: The AG found the Board's two-member Town Manager negotiating subcommittee was a public body that met without posting notice, a violation, but ordered no further relief because the Board nullified its work and restarted the review.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a Board subcommittee that negotiated the Town Manager's contract met and deliberated without posting any meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: We find this failure to be a violation of the Open Meeting Law.
